description: Quality gate G8 (ownership): path globs -> owner, derived from the ownership table and Rules in docs/workflows/team.md, which stays the source of truth (change team.md first, then this file). Checked by tools/check_ownership.py; owned by FORGE-05.
syntax: Paths are relative to the repository root with '/' separators. '*' and '?' match within one path segment; '**' matches zero or more whole segments. The most specific pattern wins: an exact file (no wildcard) beats any wildcard pattern; otherwise the pattern with more literal (wildcard-free) segments wins; then the longer literal prefix; a remaining tie between patterns that can match the same path is an error in this file. A path no pattern matches belongs to default_owner.
notes: intelligence/** and prompts/** are Codex's: the Codex row (and the FORGE-05 prompt) give them to Codex, superseding FORGE-00's 'intelligence/ (until Codex is live)'. A FORGE-00 change there is flagged.

roblox/tests/unit/contracts/**, roblox/tests/fixtures/** and roblox.yml are harness/tooling files FORGE-05 maintains (also listed in team.md's FORGE-05 row). .gitattributes has no team.md row; it is assigned to forge-05 here as repository tooling (line-ending policy CI depends on). Add it to team.md.

Brace sets in team.md ({Data,Player,...}*) are expanded to one glob per name. '*' matches one path segment, so they cover single-file modules (Services/DataService.luau) but not folder modules (Services/DataService/init.luau): add a '<Name>*/**' row when an area needs one.

Per-area game config files match games/*/config/<Name>.luau in every game folder. Everything else in games/sandbox/ is forge-05. Other games/game-00N/ paths stay with forge-00 (it creates them) until the game brief reassigns sub-folders: add rows then.

Unlisted paths belong to forge-00, e.g. README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/architecture/interfaces.md, docs/standards/, tools/forge.py, tools/tests/test_forge.py, tools/setup/, production/handoffs/TEMPLATE.md, agents/*/STATUS.md. New handoffs and each agent's own STATUS.md are opened up by the exceptions below.

Shared contracts (roblox/src/shared/Contracts/ -> forge-05 as custodian, docs/architecture/interfaces.md -> forge-00) are flagged when another worker edits them; AGENTS.md requires FORGE-05 review and FORGE-00 approval for those PRs, recorded on the PR.

exceptions.description: Any agent may add new files under production/handoffs/. Modifying, deleting or renaming an existing handoff (M, D, R) is not covered: never edit another agent's handoff; answer with a new file.

The task's owner (front-matter 'owner' of the merge-base version) may modify an existing task file only in the front-matter fields status, updated, evidence, blocked_by, actual_h and by appending lines to its '## Log' section. Any other change (title, owner, requirements, body text, existing Log lines) is a violation.
FORGE-05 may make the same status/evidence/Log edit on any task file (recording a merge or acceptance).
Each agent may add or edit its own agents/<id>/STATUS.md; the '*' segment is the agent id (agents/forge-01/STATUS.md -> forge-01, agents/codex/STATUS.md -> codex).
Codex owns intelligence/ and prompts/. This is an ordinary ownership row (see rules), listed here so the hand-over from FORGE-00 is visible; the checker verifies the rows exist.
